name: Lovable
summary: AI app builder that turns a written description into a web app with a database and hosting, published to a lovable.app address in one click. Billing is in credits whose cost per message depends on the work, and a published app's backend runs on a separate monthly Cloud allowance.
best_for: founders, marketers and small teams who want a working web app with a database from a written description, online the same day without setting up hosting
skip_if: your app must keep saving data all month on a zero budget, or your team wants to write and review the code itself rather than prompt for changes
honest_knock: You do not know what a change costs until it is done. Lovable prices each build message by the work it turns out to involve, from about half a credit for a styling tweak to two credits for a page with images, so a credit budget is an estimate, not a price list. The second catch is easy to miss: the app you publish runs its database, hosting and AI features on a separate monthly Cloud grant of 20 credits. Lovable's own documentation says a published app stays live when those credits run out, but its backend services and AI features pause, so an app that works on day one can stop saving data later in the month. The larger Pro tiers are no cheaper per credit until 1,200 credits a month, so buying ahead saves nothing below that.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-26 on lovable.dev/pricing from a European exit, so shown in euros including VAT, and in Lovable's plans-and-credits documentation) Free: 5 build credits a day, capped at 30 a month, which do not roll over; plus a monthly Cloud grant of 20 credits for hosting and backend services and 4 credits for AI features inside published apps. Pro starts at 25 euros a month for 100 credits, with a dropdown of larger credit tiers: 200 for 50 euros, 400 for 100 euros and 800 for 200 euros keep the same 25 cents a credit, and the discounts only start at 1,200 credits for 294 euros (2%), rising to 10% at 5,000 credits for 1,125 euros. Pro adds custom domains, removing the Lovable badge, credit rollover for one month, on-demand top-ups and user roles. Business starts at 50 euros a month for the same 100 credits and adds SSO, a security center, internal-only publishing and personal projects. Enterprise is a platform fee on volume pricing. Yearly billing is advertised as two months free. What a message costs depends on the work: the documentation gives about 0.50 credits for a styling change, 1.20 for adding authentication and 2.00 for a landing page with images, and Plan mode costs 1 credit a message.
